summary.en: The DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, DeepSeek V4 Pro, DeepSeek V4 Flash, Hy3, Claude Sonnet/Opus 4.6, GPT-5.4 and HY-Vision 2.0 instruct models behind Tencent Marvis, called straight through its model gateway with your QQ / WeChat sign-in — or paste an auth.json obtained elsewhere (for Android, where the browser sign-in cannot launch Chromium).
summary.zh: 把腾讯 Marvis 背后的 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash、DeepSeek V4 Pro、DeepSeek V4 Flash、Hy3、Claude Sonnet/Opus 4.6、GPT-5.4、HY-Vision 2.0 instruct 接进 magpie，用你的 QQ / 微信登录态直连它的模型网关；安卓上浏览器登录打不开时，也可粘贴别处换到的 auth.json 直接导入。
